At the same time, a work that belonged to their father who died ten years earlier in the mysterious fire of his art gallery resurfaces during a prestigious exhibition at the Eiffel Tower. They then decide to take all the risks to steal it in the hope of finally understanding what happened to it. Very quickly, the trio finds themselves in the crosshairs of Quentin Chapuis, captain of the BRB, responsible for stopping these new thieves who continue to escape him. But he doesn't know that among them is his lifelong great love, Tam... Between their chaotic reunion, full of emotion, their daily life as young women today and their new secret and perilous activity, the three sisters will have to respond to all challenges. שחקנים: Constance Labbé, Camille Lou, Claire Romain במאי: מידע נוסף על הסדרה: אתר TMDB | אתר TVDB | אתר IMDB

A devastating fire destroyed the Bazaar of Charity in a few minutes, the building housing a popular charity event, killing more than 120 people; mainly high society women and their staff. On this occasion, three women, Adrienne De Lenverpre, Alice De Jeansin, and her good Rose Rivière saw their destiny turned upside down. item.description: שם הסדרה באנגלית: Le Comte de Monte Cristo שנה: 1998 תאריך יציאה: 1998-09-07 קוד IMDB י: tt0167565 דירוג: 8 ז'אנר: הרפתקאות, דרמה, רומנטיקה אולפן: TF1 לינק לצפיה: לינק 1 | לינק 2 | לינק 3 | לינק 4 | לינק 5 | לינק 6 קדימון: לינק תקציר: A TV mini-series adaptation of the classic Alexandre Dumas novel. Edmond Dantes is falsely accused by those jealous of his good fortune, and is sentenced to spend the rest of his life in the notorious island prison, Chateau d'If. While imprisoned, he meets the Abbe Faria, a fellow prisoner whom everyone believes to be mad. The Abbe tells Edmond of a fantastic treasure hidden away on a tiny island, that only he knows the location of. After many years in prison, the old Abbe dies, and Edmond escapes disguised as the dead body. Now free, Edmond must find the treasure the Abbe told him of, so he can use the new-found wealth to exact revenge on those who have wronged him. שחקנים: ז'ראר דפארדיה, Ornella Muti, ז'אן רושפו, Michel Aumont, Pierre Arditi, Roland Blanche, Guillaume Depardieu במאי: Thierry de Peretti, Josée Dayan מידע נוסף על הסדרה: אתר TMDB | אתר TVDB | אתר IMDB
